Why Fanfares

Everything a bus organiser needs to publish, promote, and manage a trip.

Keep the experience simple for fans and operationally clear for the people running the bus.

For organisers

Create trip pages with the essentials up front so fans know where to go, what it costs, and when they need to be there.

  • Publish pickup points, times, and ticket details.
  • Keep all passenger info in one simple place.
  • Reduce back-and-forth messages on social media and WhatsApp.

For fans

Find the right bus quickly, understand the journey, and stay informed if plans change before kickoff.

  • See trip basics without hunting through group chats.
  • Get a cleaner experience on mobile.
  • Feel confident booking a place on the day.

For clubs and communities

Make travel information easier to share, improve turnout, and build a more connected matchday community.

  • Support fan groups, supporters' clubs, and independents.
  • Use a consistent format for every trip.
  • Present a more professional travel offering.
How it works

A straightforward flow from trip creation to matchday departure.

Step 1

Create the trip

Add the match, route, pickup points, price, and any notes that fans need before they book.

Step 2

Share and fill seats

Fans discover the trip and join from a clean page that keeps the important details front and centre.

Step 3

Send updates

If timings or plans change, everyone stays in the loop instead of chasing scattered messages.
